description: This file contains integration tests for the CatalogItem endpoints in the eShopOnWeb application, testing paged retrieval and concurrent API calls.

classes.name: CatalogItemListPagedEndpoint
classes.description: Test class containing integration test methods for catalog item listing API endpoints.

methods.name: ReturnsFirst10CatalogItems
methods.description: Tests that a GET request to the catalog items API returns 10 items with page size 10.

methods.name: ReturnsCorrectCatalogItemsGivenPageIndex1
methods.description: Tests that paginated retrieval with page index 1 returns the correct number of items.

methods.name: SuccessFullMutipleParallelCall
methods.description: Verifies that multiple parallel API calls to various endpoints succeed with HTTP 200 OK.
